title: Your Language Model is Its Own Critic: Reinforcement Learning with Value Estimation from Actor's Internal States
abstract: arXiv:2605.07579v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for Large Reasoning Models rests on variance reduction, which requires both a reliable baseline and high prompt diversity within each training batch. This is especially difficult in multi-domain training for general reasoning models, where prompts from different tasks induce highly diverse gradient signals. Existing approaches fall short in different ways: GRPO estimates its baseline as the group mean over rollouts from the same prompt, so an accurate baseline leaves fewer distinct prompts in the batch, while PPO avoids this trade-off by training a policy scale critic, roughly doubling the cost of training. We introduce POISE (Policy Optimization with Internal State Value Estimation), a reinforcement learning algorithm that turns the model's internal states into a value model. A lightweight probe reads the signals already computed during the forward pass to predict the basel

translated_title: 你的语言模型本身就是自己的评论家：基于Actor内部状态的价值估计强化学习
translated_abstract: 面向大型推理模型的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）依赖于方差缩减，这既需要一个可靠的基线，又需要每个训练批次内保持高度的提示多样性。这在通用推理模型的多领域训练中尤为困难，因为来自不同任务的提示会产生高度多样化的梯度信号。现有方法各有不足：GRPO将基线估计为同一提示多次采样的组均值，因此获得准确的基线就意味着批次中会留下更少的多样化提示；而PPO虽然避免了这种权衡，却需要训练一个与策略规模相当的评论家模型，使训练成本大约翻倍。我们提出了POISE（基于内部状态价值估计的策略优化），这是一种将模型自身内部状态转化为价值模型的强化学习算法。一个轻量级探针读取前向传播过程中已经计算好的信号，从而预测基线（价值）。
tldr: 该论文提出POISE算法，通过一个轻量级探针读取模型前向传播中已计算的内部状态来估计价值基线，在无需额外训练与策略同规模的评论家的情况下，同时兼顾了基线准确性与批次内提示多样性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes POISE, a reinforcement learning algorithm that uses a lightweight probe to read the actor's internal states already computed during the forward pass to estimate the value baseline, achieving accurate baselines while preserving prompt diversity without the doubled training cost of a policy-scale critic.
